messages:
julia: Heads-up - OrbitGrid marketplace tile + SI connector goes live 07:00 PT tomorrow. We need a minimal, machine-discoverable partner-SEV path for launch-watch (48h). Focus: clear routing, warm-standby, and an automated fallback.

matt: +1. Proposal: deterministic channel name #og-launch-<env>-ops (e.g. #og-launch-prod-ops). Alerts post there first, then PD paging follows timeline. Keep the runbook machine-readable (tiny JSON blob pinned).

sora: I like the JSON pin idea. Also add an initial incident-capture workflow so the first poster fills region, surface (marketplace|si|billing), customer-impact Y/N, and owner. Make that auto-pin.

lin: Timeline suggestion: 0-8m partner/SI triage in channel -> 8-20m Redwood oncall mitigation -> 20-60m partner eng deep-dive -> 60m+ open warroom if unresolved. Warm-standby: 45m shifts first 12h, 2h checks through 48h.

julia: ops-bot - can you scaffold the channel, create PD policy placeholders, and add a bridge template we can invoke automatically? Example commands in channel would be nice.

ops-bot: action: /scaffold-channel og-launch-prod-ops --pins runbook.json,checklist.md --invite @julia,@matt,@sora,@lin; /create-pd-policy OG_LAUNCH_PD; /create-bridge-template og-launch-warroom --auto-status 30m

matt: For webhooks: include customer_impact boolean and surfaces array. Rule: if customer_impact==true AND severity>=high -> page PD immediately and create bridge. If surfaces contains 2+ entries -> auto-create bridge.

sora: I'll author the pinned JSON runbook. Minimal example I'll include (as text):
```
{"alerts":"orbitgrid.launch.*","channel":"#og-launch-prod-ops","pd":"OG_LAUNCH_PD","escalation":[{"mins":0,"owner":"partner-support"},{"mins":8,"owner":"redwood-oncall"},{"mins":20,"owner":"partner-eng"}],"postmortem_trigger":"sev2_within_72h"}
```

lin: Nice. Also add a short rollback guardrail for SI connector flips (command and safe-tag). Pin it. Make sure the dry-run validates the webhook payload shape.

julia: One more ops ask: include a short comms snippet we can paste to partner CSMs on first alert: 
"We are monitoring in #og-launch-prod-ops (warm-watch 48h). Incident owner: <owner>. Next update in 30m unless resolved."

ops-bot: note: automation rule created: if alert.surfaces_count>=2 OR (alert.customer_impact==true AND alert.severity>="high") -> create bridge og-launch-warroom; page OG_LAUNCH_PD; notify @julia,@matt

matt: Add postmortem rule in runbook: any Sev2+ within 72h -> assign partner_eng_lead + release_manager. Also add rule to stamp incident metadata into our incident tracker via webhook.

sora: I'll drop the runbook and checklist into the channel today. Can someone own the dry-run? Would like to validate PD paging and bridge creation.

lin: I'll run the dry-run tonight and post results. One small thing  include an "auto-status" every 30m during active incidents with owner,surface,status,next_steps. That reduces noise for CSMs.

julia: Perfect. After dry-run and PD ids are set, I'll add a 1-line ops paragraph into the launch announcement linking to the channel and runbook. Thanks everyone :rocket:
